title: The Network and Information Systems Regulations 2018
role_note: NOT the official register. This is the revised text as re-served by Lex, an experimental API of the UK government's Incubator for AI (i.AI), which says its data is sourced from legislation.gov.uk. legislation.gov.uk itself answered every request from this session with an AWS WAF challenge (HTTP 202, x-amzn-waf-action: challenge, no content), which COMMON.md treats as a no; the official text was therefore NOT read and the encoding was NOT checked against it. Lex's rendering differs in form from the register: provisions inserted after 2018 (14A, A20, 19A, 8A, 19B) come first, Schedule 1's table is flattened to one line, provisions are labelled 'Section N)', omitted words appear as '...' or a row of dots, and Schedule 3 (if any) is absent.
